description:
Affected extension: event-bus-demo.ex
Upstream: pi.events is an EventEmitter built directly into the ExtensionAPI. Extensions call pi.events.on(name, handler) to subscribe and pi.events.emit(name, data) to publish. Multiple extensions sharing a session share the same bus instance, enabling true inter-extension messaging.
Current workaround: a separate EventBus GenServer must be started externally and passed to init/2 as a pid. The factory that loads the extension is responsible for providing the bus, breaking the self-contained extension model.
What's needed: API.t() must include an events field (a pid or fn-pair for emit/subscribe) that is wired at bind_core time. The bus should be session-scoped so all extensions in a session share it.
Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/event-bus.ts (pi.events.on + pi.events.emit)
title: pi.events — built-in event bus on the extension API
